_readme.purpose: Every translatable string on the Dom na Travni gori website, in one file. Locale: en.
howToTranslate: Translate ONLY the values. Never change, translate, reorder or drop a key.
Return the exact same JSON shape with the same key set — one file per target locale.
Keep the brand name "Planinski dom na Travni gori" / "Dom na Travni gori" untranslated.
Keep prices, allergen codes and the "≈ NN min" number format unchanged; the unit word may be localized.
Slovenian dish names under menu.* are the original menu wording — keep them for sl, translate (or gloss) them for other locales.
Some values are still placeholder copy ("Lorem ipsum", "MOCK") — translate them literally or flag them; do not invent replacements.
A value that is an empty string is intentionally unused — keep it empty, keep the key.

sections.ui: UI strings — becomes src/i18n/<locale>.ts (the key set must match exactly).
sections.content: Content-collection fields — becomes src/content/<collection>/<locale>/*.json. Key format: <collection>.<entry-id>.<field>, and menu.sections.<i>.items.<j>.<field> for the menu.

ui.home.welcome.title: Cozy apartments in the heart of the forest
ui.home.welcome.lead: Leave the city behind and find quiet on Travna Gora, a high mountain plateau above the Ribnica valley, covered in forest. Open meadows sit between the trees, the forest comes right up to your apartment, and the air still smells like forest, not traffic. Come to slow down, breathe deeply and explore a quiet corner of Slovenia few travelers ever find.
ui.home.welcome.imageAlt: Planinski dom na Travni gori — the house surrounded by forest
ui.home.heritage.title: One house, many generations
ui.home.heritage.intro: Enjoy your vacation in a house that has welcomed travelers and explorers for almost 100 years — of course, with modern room comforts.
ui.home.heritage.m1.title: A lodge on the mountain
ui.home.heritage.m1.body: In 1927, the house opened as a planinski dom — a mountain lodge where hikers and travelers stopped to rest, eat, and warm up after a day on the trails.
ui.home.heritage.m1.alt: Archival photograph of the house in its early years, with a horse and cart out front
ui.home.heritage.m2.title: Long tables, full house
ui.home.heritage.m2.body: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet — a gathering place where neighbours and wanderers paused at long outdoor tables.
ui.home.heritage.m2.alt: Archival photograph of a crowd gathered at outdoor tables outside the house
ui.home.heritage.m3.title: The ski years
ui.home.heritage.m3.body: By the late 1960s the slopes below the house had become a small ski centre, with a lift and wooden bungalows — winter brought whole families up the mountain for the day.
ui.home.heritage.m3.alt: Vintage postcard of Travna Gora: skiers on the slope below the house, and a wooden bungalow
ui.home.heritage.m4.title: The house today
ui.home.heritage.m4.body: Nearly a century later, the same house is still standing — lovingly restored with modern comforts, ready to welcome you for a stay you won't forget.
ui.home.heritage.m4.alt: Modern colour photograph of the house as it stands today

ui.home.apartments.intro: Warm, characterful rooms deep in the Slovenian countryside — forest all around and home-cooked food on the table.

ui.home.apartments.rooms.text: Fresh, cozy rooms for groups of any size — a warm welcome for big families, couples, and solo travelers alike.

ui.home.apartments.slovenia.title: Heart of Slovenia
ui.home.apartments.slovenia.text: A great location close to some of Slovenia’s best-known sights — Ljubljana and the karst caves among them, with lakes, forests and castles all within about an hour’s drive.
ui.home.apartments.slovenia.b1: About an hour’s drive to most major sights
ui.home.apartments.slovenia.b2: Close to Ljubljana and the famous karst caves — Postojna and Križna jama

ui.home.apartments.nature.text: Wake up beside one of Europe’s most beautiful forests — fall asleep to birdsong, and if you’re lucky, deer will wander by to say hello.

ui.home.gallery.title: The mood of the house, inside and out
ui.home.gallery.intro: A small gallery for the quiet details: warm corners, evening light, forest edges and slow breakfasts outdoors.
ui.home.gallery.outro.title: Book more than an apartment
ui.home.gallery.outro.text: Come for the quiet rooms, stay for the slower mornings, long-table dinners and the feeling of having somewhere to exhale.
ui.home.findUs.title: Where we are, and how to get here
ui.home.findUs.intro: Tucked away on Travna Gora in Slovenia’s Notranjska region — close enough to reach with ease, far enough to feel like another world.
ui.home.findUs.mapTitle: Map showing the location of Planinski dom na Travni gori
ui.home.findUs.pin.name: Planinski dom na Travni gori
ui.home.findUs.tip.title: The easier way up the mountain
ui.home.findUs.tip.text: It is not about saving minutes — it is about a calmer drive. Take the marked route through Sodražica: it stays wide and well-kept the whole way up. The road further south is narrower and runs along a steep cliff edge, so we suggest leaving that one to the locals.
ui.home.findUs.tip.alt: Route map showing the easier, well-kept drive up to Planinski dom na Travni gori

ui.accommodation.hero.title: Cozy apartments with a view of true Slovenian nature
ui.accommodation.hero.lead: High on the Travna Gora plateau, our house sits right at the edge of the forest, where the air is cool and the fog settles slowly over the trees each morning. Two cozy apartments, warmed by wood and quiet, are built for guests who come to slow down.
ui.accommodation.hero.body: The drive up winds through forest before opening onto the plateau, with free parking right at the door. From the terrace, the view rolls over the treetops toward the valley below — a good place for a coffee at dawn or a glass of wine as the fog rolls in.

ui.accommodation.kitchen.title: Breakfast & the homemade kitchen
ui.accommodation.kitchen.lead: There is nothing quite like the smell of fresh bread and coffee drifting through the house in the morning. Breakfast here is homemade, unhurried, and made the way it always used to be — with local, seasonal ingredients rather than anything out of a packet.
ui.accommodation.kitchen.body: Take it out to the terrace with the mountain air still cool, or linger at the table as long as you like — mornings at Travna Gora are for slowing down. And when you feel like cooking your own, our fully equipped guest kitchen is yours to use, stocked and ready whenever hunger strikes.

ui.sauna.title: Wood-fired sauna
ui.sauna.body: After a day in the forest there is nothing better than heat, wood and quiet. The sauna is wood-fired, the way it has always been here — give it time to warm through, then step out into the cool mountain air.
ui.sauna.point1: A modern sauna with everything you need

ui.testimonials.intro: Don’t just take our word for it — here’s what guests had to say after their stay at Travna Gora.
ui.testimonials.t1.quote: We arrived very late and were still welcomed and checked in — a wonderful place. A special thank you for the delicious breakfast! Beautiful views.
ui.testimonials.t1.author: Ayura7
ui.testimonials.t2.quote: Wonderful fresh air and a perfect place to relax — we stayed in the new room and everything was excellent. Don’t miss the dumplings and mushroom soup!
ui.testimonials.t2.author: Yevheniia
ui.testimonials.t3.quote: We loved everything, and this wasn’t our first stay. Many thanks to the hosts for their friendly welcome and warm hospitality.

ui.testimonials.t4.quote: A wonderfully rich, peaceful place, far away from civilization.

ui.testimonials.t5.quote: A wonderful place to relax in a quiet, peaceful spot. Beautiful forest, comfortable conditions in the cottage, and very hospitable hosts. The food was delicious — especially the dumplings, pelmeni, mushroom soup and pancakes. Both we and the kids were absolutely delighted.

ui.activities.title: Discover Slovenia from Travna Gora
ui.activities.intro: Travna Gora is a quiet place to slow down — yet from this forested corner of Slovenia many of the country’s best-loved sights are an easy day trip away. Wake to birdsong and forest air, then set out for caves, castles, lakes and the capital, most within about an hour’s drive.
ui.activities.hero.badge.title: ≈ 1 hour
ui.activities.doorstep.title: Straight out the door
ui.activities.doorstep.intro: You don’t have to go far. Trails, forest tracks and viewpoints begin at Travna Gora itself and around the nearby mountain hut Koča na Kamnem Griču.
ui.activities.trips.title: Slovenia within an hour’s drive
ui.activities.trips.intro: Set between Ljubljana and Slovenia’s famous karst caves, Travna Gora makes an ideal base for exploring — most of these highlights are well under an hour away.
ui.activities.why.title: A quiet corner, close to everything

ui.activities.why.b3: A chance to see brown bears in the wild

content.activities.01-hiking.title: Hiking & viewpoints
content.activities.01-hiking.description: Marked trails and panoramic viewpoints start right at Travna Gora and around the nearby mountain hut Koča na Kamnem Griču.
content.activities.02-cycling.title: Cycling the forest trails
content.activities.02-cycling.description: Quiet forest tracks through the Velika Gora woods make for easy rides straight from the door, with barely a car in sight.
content.activities.03-sights.title: Forests of Velika Gora
content.activities.03-sights.description: Some of Europe’s largest forests wrap around the house — perfect for slow walks and, in season, picking mushrooms and wild berries.
content.destinations.01-ljubljana.name: Ljubljana
content.destinations.01-ljubljana.description: Slovenia’s compact, walkable capital — a riverside old town, a hilltop castle and easy café afternoons.
content.destinations.02-postojna-cave.name: Postojna Cave
content.destinations.02-postojna-cave.descriptio: One of the world’s great karst caves, explored by a little underground train through vast chambers.
content.destinations.03-predjama-castle.name: Predjama Castle
content.destinations.03-predjama-castle.descript: A dramatic medieval castle built straight into the mouth of a cliffside cave.
content.destinations.04-krizna-cave.name: Križna Cave (Cross Cave)
content.destinations.04-krizna-cave.description: One of Europe’s most beautiful water caves, discovered by boat across a chain of underground emerald lakes.
content.destinations.05-bear-watching.name: Brown bear watching (Kočevsko)
content.destinations.05-bear-watching.descriptio: Guided watching of brown bears in the wild, in the vast forests of the Kočevsko region.
content.destinations.06-lake-kocevje.name: Lake Kočevje
content.destinations.06-lake-kocevje.description: A calm town lake ringed by forest — good for a swim, a paddle or a slow walk around the shore.
content.destinations.07-nova-stifta-trail.name: Nova Štifta – Travna Gora forest trail
content.destinations.07-nova-stifta-trail.descri: A pleasant forest trail through untouched fir-beech woods and past historical waypoints, leading all the way to Dom na Travni Gori — well suited to families and casual hikers looking for quiet and fresh mountain air in the Kočevje forest. About 1 hour's walk one way.
